messages.author: 891813bfbff9f848
messages.subject: y-axis padding
parts:
Hi,

I have noticed that ggplot2 normally adds some extra padding below and
above the minimum and maximum values that should be plotted.
Is there a way to specify the width or percentage of this padding?
I would like to plot some text underneath my data points, but they
currently fall beneath the x-axis.
Since I want this to work in facets as well (with different scales) I
cannot just adjust the y-axis.

Kind regards,

Willem
